title: Digital Marketing: Georgia and Israel deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Use freelancers for design and video with a one-page brief and a delivery date.
Public holidays and the working week differ; put the working days on every delivery promise.
Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?
Employment rules, notice and social contributions differ; read the one for the country of the worker. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Licences vary by activity (food, health, money, education centres); list yours before the first order. Check with a local expert.
Write GEL next to every number.
Cluster G, Money services (regulated): Regulated money services; plan as a partner of a licensed firm. Check with a local expert.
Trust: registration number, address, delivery days and a refund note on every page. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Languages differ by customer: write the page in the local language plus English.
Language: one page in the local language, one in English; never mix currencies on one price.
Use freelancers for design and video with a one-page brief and a delivery date.
Keep a local address and a named contact in the country where you trade.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Both have strong technology and start-up activity; many small firms sell abroad from day one.
Build a proof page: one case with before and after numbers.
Moving data between the two countries or to a third place may need a safeguard; check with a local expert.
Keep a risk list with a response for each; include a rules change. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Find and serve customers Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Keep a local address and a named contact in the country where you trade.
Language: one page in the local language, one in English; never mix currencies on one price.
Written terms and signed copies for every helper, even part-time.
Compare the types by tax, liability and filing work before you choose; write the table. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Price, tax and money Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Moving data between the two countries or to a third place may need a safeguard; check with a local expert.
Break-even units = fixed monthly cost divided by contribution per unit; round up.
Local caution: the final country choice will be confirmed before opening.
Cluster H, People and business support: Coaching, coworking and outsourcing fit; many founders need flexible support in more than one language.

questions.q: In "People and partners Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Freelancers are common: write scope, price, language and date in one page.
Say in plain words what you collect and why; give a way to see and correct it.
Channels: messaging apps and social media are strong in both; add a local marketplace.
Trust: registration number, address, delivery days and a refund note on every page. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Launch plan and review Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Break-even units = fixed monthly cost divided by contribution per unit; round up.
Launch with three pilot clients and a review at day 30.
Employment rules, notice and social contributions differ; read the one for the country of the worker. Check with a local expert.
Price per month with a clear scope and report; add a set-up fee for the first month.
